issues.title: Broken Cross-References (Deep-Walker Cap)
issues.why: The spec explicitly references files like '02-error-architecture/01-error-handling-reference.md' and '03-error-code-registry/error-codes-master.json' which are not provided in the context due to the 90KB truncation.
issues.fix: Provide the full content of the '02-error-architecture' and '03-error-code-registry' subfolders in the prompt context.

issues.title: Missing GWT for Core Logic
issues.why: While §97 lists ACs, many lack specific 'Verifies' clauses for the complex logic described in the retrospectives (e.g., the IIFE closure dedup lock in 01-error-resolution/03-retrospectives/02-retry-debounce-dedup-fixes.md).
issues.fix: Add explicit GWT criteria for the API-layer dedup lock and WebSocket completion lock patterns.

issues.title: Inconsistent Error Code Regex
issues.why: AC-04 defines the pattern as '^[A-Z]{2,4}-[0-9]{3}-[0-9]{2}$', but the JSON Schema in §00 uses '^[A-Z]{2,5}-[A-Z]+-\d{3}$'.
issues.fix: Unify all error code regex patterns to the '^[A-Z]{2,5}-[A-Z]+-\d{3}$' standard across all files.
